spec.hypothesis: Type confusability (BCS) independently predicts extraction degradation in MAVEN Event Detection, replicating Few-NERD finding cross-task (NER→ED). Analysis focus: pairwise + per-type (not batch-level due to BCS compression).
spec.design: exp1: count curve {1,6,12,24,42,84,168} x 5 random; exp2: count={12,24} x 27 batches. Qwen3 BCS matrix. 149 active types. Analysis: Layer 1 pairwise SCS-confusion + Layer 2 per-type F1 vs mean SCS + Layer 3 batch-level percentile rank BCS.
spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/schema-dag-extraction && python3 src/run_experiment.py --dataset maven --mode exp1 ... && python3 src/run_experiment.py --dataset maven --mode exp2 ..."

experiment_data.notes: MAVEN 三层分析完成。Layer 1 pairwise 不显著（BCS 压缩）。Layer 2 per-type 显著但方向相反（r=+0.189, p=0.021, 高 BCS → 高 F1）。Layer 3 batch-level 不显著（n=5 per group）。Cross-task replication 部分失败：MAVEN 的 same-domain event space 下 embedding similarity 不是 confusability 的有效 proxy，而是 type centrality/typicality 的指标。Top confused pairs 有语义直觉（Achieve↔Getting, Death↔Killing），但 SCS 与 confusion count 无统计相关。需要 Framing 调整。

metrics.key_finding: MAVEN batch-level: high_bcs relaxed_F1 2.4x vs low_bcs (count_6). Direction same as Few-NERD batch-level (positive). Pairwise + per-type analysis needed to control frequency confound.
metrics.note: exact_F1 very low (0.003-0.035), relaxed_F1 usable (0.089-0.247). Event trigger boundary matching is fuzzy. A re-run (500 samples) is still in progress in artifacts/exp004/.
